searchText: wanted to ask what other client teams do for this endpoint https://ethereum.github.io/beacon-APIs/?urls.primaryName=dev#/Node/getSyncingStatus https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/issues/14226 i guess for prysm we have el_offline if it's syncing , maybe we missed checking for some standard response from els there's not too much description on the API to describe what conditions these fields are based on the consensus perspective isn't there `is_optimistic` for that purpose? I guess the way we have it it's based on forkchoice store and not on EL status yeah same here although i didn't implement our prysm endpoint for this, it seems like our cl is interpreting the el as offline if it gives any error in connection be it syncing or 401 restricted access i guess maybe other clients don't interpret it that way it is "online" I guess that part is off the spec, we have those EL states ``` export enum ExecutionEngineState { ONLINE = "ONLINE", OFFLINE = "OFFLINE", SYNCING = "SYNCING", SYNCED = "SYNCED", AUTH_FAILED = "AUTH_FAILED", } ``` and `OFFLINE` is the only state that will report as `el_offline: true` hmm i'll go back to check thanks iirc it was the lighthouse team that first used this, as per https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/4295 error or 401 due restricted access seems to be used to set `el_offline: true`, although calling `newPayload` on syncing EL should not return an error? there is a bit more discussion here https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/290#issuecomment-1560056619 Is anyone working on an endpoint to generate merkle proofs for a given path in the beacon state?

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: I guess the way we have it it's based on forkchoice store and not on EL status

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: although i didn't implement our prysm endpoint for this, it seems like our cl is interpreting the el as offline if it gives any error in connection be it syncing or 401 restricted access

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: i guess maybe other clients don't interpret it that way it is "online"

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
I guess that part is off the spec, we have those EL states
```
export enum ExecutionEngineState {
  ONLINE = "ONLINE",
  OFFLINE = "OFFLINE",
  SYNCING = "SYNCING",
  SYNCED = "SYNCED",
  AUTH_FAILED = "AUTH_FAILED",
}
```

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: and `OFFLINE` is the only state that will report as `el_offline: true`

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: hmm i'll go back to check thanks

excerpts.content: iirc it was the lighthouse team that first used this, as per https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/pull/4295 error or 401 due restricted access seems to be used to set `el_offline: true`, although calling `newPayload` on syncing EL should not return an error?
